nodes.summary: Let $X$ be a finite set, $p \in [0, 1]$, and $\mathcal F$ a family of subsets of $X$. Then $\mathcal F$ is weakly $p$-small if there is a function $g$ from subsets of $X$ to the nonnegative reals such that $\sum_{S \subseteq T} g(S) \ge 1$ for every $T \in \mathcal F$ and $\sum_{S \subseteq X} g(S)\, p^{|S|} \le 1/2$.
nodes.title: Weakly $p$-small families

nodes.summary: A real number $K$, not yet specified, that is to serve as the universal constant in the bound of the threshold of an increasing family by $K$ times its fractional expectation-threshold times the logarithm of the size of its largest minimal element.
nodes.title: The constant of the Frankston–Kahn–Narayanan–Park theorem

nodes.summary: For a family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of a set $X$, $\ell(\mathcal F)$ is the largest cardinality of a minimal element of $\mathcal F$ (minimal with respect to inclusion), a natural number.
nodes.title: Size of a largest minimal element, $\ell(\mathcal F)$

nodes.summary: For a set $X$ and $p \in [0, 1]$, let $\mu_p$ be the $p$-biased product measure on subsets of $X$, under which each element of $X$ lies in the random subset independently with probability $p$. For a family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $X$, $p_c(\mathcal F)$ is some $p \in [0, 1]$ with $\mu_p(\mathcal F) = 1/2$ if such a $p$ exists, and $0$ otherwise.
nodes.title: The threshold $p_c(\mathcal F)$

nodes.summary: For a family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of a finite set $X$, $q_f(\mathcal F)$ is the supremum, in $[0, 1]$, of the set of all $p \in [0, 1]$ such that $\mathcal F$ is weakly $p$-small; it is $0$ if there is no such $p$.
nodes.title: The fractional expectation-threshold $q_f(\mathcal F)$

nodes.summary: Let $K$ be the universal real constant still to be supplied. For every finite set $X$ and every increasing family $\mathcal F$ of subsets of $X$ (closed under taking supersets) with $\ell(\mathcal F) \ge 2$, where $\ell(\mathcal F)$ is the size of a largest minimal element of $\mathcal F$,

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
